description: Reject applications that are waiting for the user's review. A rejected application is skipped: nothing is sent to the employer and none of the user's applications is spent. A rejection cannot be undone with these tools. Pass 1 to 25 application_ids from getmattered_get_applications. Reject only the applications the user said no to. Do not use it to stop an application that is queued or still being prepared; use getmattered_cancel_applications. Next: getmattered_get_matches for other jobs.

application_ids.description: Application ids to act on, 1 to 25 (e.g. [1550, 1551]), from getmattered_get_applications

name: getmattered_reject_applications

decision.description: The operation that ran: approve, reject, cancel, refine, re_prepare or set_stage.

notConfirmed.description: True when the user declined the confirmation prompt and nothing was sent.

reason.description: Machine reason when ok is false, or "already_approved" for an approve that had already gone through.

status.description: Our own record after the action. Never proof the employer received it.

title: Reject Applications
